betalent_skills.name: Communication
betalent_skills.label: Articulate
betalent_skills.description: Energised by explaining things clearly; expresses self easily, clearly and succinctly; articulates concepts logically; adapts communication style to audience; inspires and engages
betalent_skills.ldc_strength: Highly articulate — effectively breaks down complexity for others; creates safe and open space for conversations
betalent_skills.ldc_development: Risk of overusing articulateness under pressure — can appear overconfident or repetitive; allow others space to bring in their perspective
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Can appear overconfident; may over-simplify; under pressure seen as superior by colleagues
sample_achievements: Toastmasters International - Won Best Speaker award at Toastmasters International club meetings
Toastmasters International - Won Best Table Topic Speaker award at Toastmasters International club meetings
IBM - Completed IBM Foundational Competency: Presentation Skills

betalent_skills.name: Attention to Detail
betalent_skills.label: Meticulous
betalent_skills.description: Energised by accuracy; delivers to highest standard; rigorously proofs own work and others'; gives detailed instructions; avoids shortcuts; consistently produces high quality comprehensive work
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Can become perfectionist; produces work slower in time-critical periods; benefit from prioritising pace on task-by-task basis
sample_achievements: Philips - Natural leader who inspires and motivates people across all levels regardless of reporting lines, seniority, or team boundaries

betalent_skills.name: Analytical Thinking
betalent_skills.label: Evaluative
betalent_skills.description: Solution-focused; energised by identifying problems and their causes; rigorous and objective; gathers information from multiple sources; justifies decisions with objective facts and evidence
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: May struggle with intuitive/impulsive thinking; requires support when faced with urgent problems; uncomfortable cutting corners

betalent_skills.name: Values-based Leadership
betalent_skills.label: Genuine
betalent_skills.description: Driven by principles; demonstrates loyalty and commitment; gains mutual trust; recognises value of honest communication environments
sample_achievements: Karnataka State Brahmin Development Board (KSBDB) - Kept teachers spell bound by simple, straight and lucid language for entire sixty minutes

betalent_skills.name: Authenticity
betalent_skills.label: Genuine
betalent_skills.description: Energised by maintaining values and beliefs; communicates openly and honestly; earns mutual trust; openly shares limitations; demonstrates core values at all times
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Can become rigid in beliefs; may share too much information leading to loss of business deals or sharing worrying information without reassuring colleagues

betalent_skills.name: Goal Orientation
betalent_skills.label: Achiever
betalent_skills.description: Energised by accomplishment; sets stretching goals for self and others; future-focused and determined; inspires others to perform at highest level; driven towards excellence
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Potential to become overstretched; setting increasingly difficult targets can lead to stress and burnout; puts unnecessary pressure on self and others

betalent_skills.name: Network Building
betalent_skills.label: Networker
betalent_skills.description: Energised by building relationships; builds strong relationships with key internal/external stakeholders; acts strategically when networking; understands political landscape; new relationships mutually beneficial
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Desire to push self forward when building professional friendships can appear forceful and unnatural

betalent_skills.name: Self-Awareness
betalent_skills.label: Self-Aware
betalent_skills.description: Energised by being in touch with inner self; clear awareness of own emotions and impact on others; actively seeks development feedback; reflective and intuitive; maintains high professionalism in emotional situations
betalent_skills.overuse_risk: Tendency to over-interpret situations; can ruminate; over-attribute reasons for situations to self rather than other influences

betalent_skills.name: Innovation
betalent_skills.label: Innovative
betalent_skills.description: Rank 8 — energised by suggesting improvements to working practices; generates novel ways of working; creative and conceptual thinker; does not automatically accept the status quo
sample_achievements: IBM - Received IBM Bravo Award (The Best of IBM) for innovation and event organizing
IBM - Won 1st place (best implementation project) in Pune at IBM India Hackday 8

betalent_skills.name: Positive Thinking
betalent_skills.label: Positive
betalent_skills.description: Rank 9 — energised by remaining optimistic and upbeat in adversity; confident in ability to control events; focuses on achievements and positive outcomes
sample_achievements: Philips - Great learning experience working with Datta

betalent_skills.name: Flexibility
betalent_skills.label: Flexible
betalent_skills.description: Rank 11 — energised by taking an open and adaptable approach; action-oriented; works positively when faced with change or ambiguity

betalent_skills.name: Strategic Thinking
betalent_skills.label: Future-Focused
betalent_skills.description: Rank 14 — energised by thinking strategically and articulating a clear direction for the future; goal-oriented and visionary; makes confident decisions towards a better future
betalent_skills.ldc_strength: Ability to draw trends from data and make conclusions; focused on competitive disruption
betalent_skills.ldc_development: Explicitly link plans to organizational strategy; connect big picture with granular actions
